pr.title: feat(rules): multi-condition mute rules with per-field regex
pr.body: feat(rules): multi-condition mute rules with per-field regex Lets one `[[rules.mute]]` rule combine conditions — all must match (AND) — so you can scope a mute instead of muting a whole author: ```toml [[rules.mute]] author = "github-actions[bot]" excerpt = "CircleCI pipeline triggered" ``` Flat fields (`author`/`title`/`excerpt`, each with an optional `_regex`) compose with the existing single `match`/`pattern` form (unchanged, still works). A rule with **no** conditions is a config error — otherwise "all match" is vacuously true and it would mute the whole feed. Closes #54.
